I can't answer that. Nothing in the firm's stored knowledge mentions Telltale, so I don't know what it has instructed. If Telltale is another client, its instructions are confidential to that client, and I shouldn't use them as a template for Joad. Joad's own instructions are what govern C-2.

**Expert reports**
- Joad has given no specific instruction on how expert reports are reviewed. I won't assume one or borrow another client's process. We should confirm the review process with General Counsel Evander Thorsby.
- What Joad has said about experts:
  - Consult Joad and get its approval before engaging any testifying expert.
  - Give Joad names and credentials for review before engagement. The firm's general practice is to offer several candidates per discipline.
  - Joad prefers design testimony to stay focused on the product at issue. It also offered to help identify candidates with standards-body experience.
  - Give at least ten days' notice of any proposed testing and provide quotes before commissioning it.
  - Keep a tight circle around who sees test files.
  - Do not put forward any Joad employee or key witness for testimony until the firm and Thorsby have discussed it.
  - Send all communications through Thorsby.

**Timing of settlement talks**
- Any settlement above the insurer's pre-approved tier needs written board of directors sign-off. Verbal indications from directors or officers are not enough.
- Joad needs about three weeks to prepare a board consent, so we should build that lead time into the schedule.
- No offer above the authorized tier may be made or communicated, even as a signal, until written sign-off is in hand.
- For any offer within the insurer's tier, check with Thorsby first, because the insurer will want to be involved.
- Copy claims handler Perpetua Wallace on anything bearing on coverage. The policy has a $400,000 retention, and Joad is watching the aggregate limit because of two other open claims.
- The firm should first give Joad an assessment and a recommended settlement range.

If you have Telltale's instructions from a source you are authorized to use, send them and I can compare. Otherwise, I can draft a proposed protocol for Joad based on its own instructions and send it to Thorsby for confirmation.
